Problem: Sort by Frequency (Stable Order)
You are given an array of N integers.
Sort the array based on the frequency of elements in descending order.
Rules:
Element with higher frequency comes first
If two elements have the same frequency, the one that appeared first in the original array should come first.
Print the full array after sorting.
📥 Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
📤 Output Format
Print the sorted array.
📌 Example Explanation
Input
7
4 5 6 5 4 3 4
Frequency:
4 → 3 times
5 → 2 times
6 → 1 time
3 → 1 time
Sorted by frequency (descending):
4 4 4 5 5 6 3
(6 appears before 3 because 6 appeared earlier in original array)
Output
4 4 4 5 5 6 3
